welcome: Welcome to Headland House. We love this place, and we hope you do too. Swim in the pool, borrow a board and watch the bay from the deck. Everything you need is on this screen, and we hope you have a lovely stay.

rules.title: Quiet hours
rules.body: Please keep noise low from 10pm to 7am. Sound carries well across the bay.

rules.title: Pool
rules.body: Swim at your own risk. Children must have an adult watching them at all times. Please shower off sunscreen before you get in.

rules.title: No smoking
rules.body: No smoking or vaping inside the house. Please use the outside areas and put butts in a bin.

rules.title: Guest numbers
rules.body: The house sleeps 8. Please check with the host before you invite visitors or hold a party.

rules.title: Surfboards
rules.body: Feel free to borrow the boards. Rinse them with fresh water after each surf and put them back where you found them.

rules.title: Pool hours
rules.body: The pool is open from 7am to 9pm. Please keep the gate shut at all times.

rules.title: Parking
rules.body: Two cars fit in the garage and one on the drive. Please don't park on the grass or across the neighbour's driveway.

rules.title: Pets
rules.body: Sorry, no pets inside the house. Assistance animals are always welcome.

rules.title: Music
rules.body: Speakers on the deck go off at 10pm. Inside speakers are fine at a low volume.

howto.title: Wi-Fi, door code and air conditioning
howto.body: All of these are on this TV. Scan the QR code to open the same page on your phone.

howto.title: Outdoor shower
howto.body: Use it after the beach or the pool. Please keep sandy feet and wet towels out of the house.

howto.title: Surfboards
howto.body: Check the board for dings before you go out. Tell us if you break one. Always check the surf and swim between the flags.

howto.title: Rubbish and recycling
howto.body: Put rubbish and recycling in the right bins. Ask the host if you are unsure about bin night.

howto.title: Speakers
howto.body: There are speakers in the living room, on the deck and in the main bedroom. Play, pause and change the volume from the TV or the Guest remote. To play your own music, connect your phone to the speaker with AirPlay or Spotify Connect.

howto.title: Pool heater
howto.body: Turn the heater on from the Smart home tile on the TV. The water warms about one degree every two hours.

howto.title: Barbecue
howto.body: The gas barbecue is on the deck. Turn the bottle on at the valve, then light it with the button. Please give the grill a scrape when you are done.

howto.title: Bins
howto.body: Red lid is general rubbish, yellow lid is recycling, green lid is garden and food scraps. Bins go out on Sunday night.

items.name: Raes Dining Room
items.note: A special dinner in a bright, breezy room at Wategos Beach.

items.name: Pixie Food & Wine
items.note: Relaxed coastal Italian with a very good wine list.

items.name: Beach Byron Bay
items.note: Casual coastal dining with ocean views over Clarkes Beach.

items.name: The Balcony Bar & Oyster Co.
items.note: Oysters and drinks above Jonson Street. Good for a casual lunch.

items.name: Cape Byron Lighthouse
items.note: Built in 1901. Walk up for big views of the coast.

items.name: Cape Byron Walking Track
items.note: A loop of about 3.7 km, around 2 hours. You can walk just a short section.

items.name: Whale watching from the headland
items.note: Humpbacks head south from September to November. Bring binoculars.

items.name: Little Wategos
items.note: A quiet little beach and lookout, just off the main track.

items.name: Bayleaf Cafe
items.note: A local favourite for breakfast and a good flat white.

items.name: Folk
items.note: Easy, friendly cafe for coffee and a bite.

items.name: Barefoot Brew Room
items.note: Early starts for a quick coffee before the beach.

items.name: Wategos Beach
items.note: A lovely beach for a swim. Toilets are close by.

items.name: The Pass
items.note: A popular spot for surfing and a swim.

items.name: Clarkes Beach
items.note: A long beach near town. Easy to walk to the cafes.

items.name: Captain Cook Lookout
items.note: A great view along the track. Good at sunrise.

items.name: The Pass to Wategos
items.note: A short coastal walk between two beaches.

steps: Strip the beds and leave the sheets in a pile
Put dirty towels in the laundry
Wash up and run the dishwasher
Take out the rubbish and recycling
Rinse the surfboards and put them back
Turn off the air conditioning and lights

emergency.name: Your host Mia (message in the Airbnb app)
